messages:
Tara (Sales): Quick alert — customer 'Nimbus Labs' running a large dataset import into the sandbox keeps getting 429s on embeddings. Demo in ~3 hours. Need a fast mitigation. acct:NIM-900.

Ravi (SE): Which endpoint and approximate QPS? Any response headers or body?

Tara (Sales): /v1/embeddings. They sent ~40 concurrent workers, each sending 5 requests/sec. Curl shows: HTTP/1.1 429, X-RateLimit-Remaining:0, X-RateLimit-Reset:1780012450, body: {"error":"rate_limited","detail":"per_route_cap"}.

Nina (Infra): per_route_cap hit. Their account-level quota still had room. Likely route reservation (per-route burst window) exhausted because client parallelized single-row requests. Two choices: 1) reduce client parallelism / add tokenized batching OR 2) grant a temporary per-route reservation.

Ravi (SE): Can we confirm they aren't doing 1k tiny requests instead of batch? Tara — any app logs?

Tara (Sales): Sanitzed logs attached in ticket. Confirmed: they do 1 request per row (not batched).

Leo (Oncall): I can apply a temporary +150rps reservation to /v1/embeddings for NIM-900 for 6 hours. That should cover the demo. Applying now and auditing for noisy neighbors.

sdk-bot: Temporary reservation created: +150 rps for route "/v1/embeddings" on acct:NIM-900 until 1780016000. Ref: TKT-8427. :white_check_mark:

Ravi (SE): Also pushing an immediate client-side recommendation: change client to send up to 64 items per embeddings call (batch), or throttle concurrency to ~8 workers. Add exponential backoff on 429s. Example snippet (node):
```js
for (let i=0;i<5;i++) {
  try { await client.embeddings.batch(...); break; }
  catch (e) { if (e.code===429) await sleep((2**i)*100 + Math.random()*50); else throw e; }
}
```

Tara (Sales): I told the customer we'll throttle them and asked them to switch to batched calls for the demo. They prefer not to change code right now; want platform-side fix.

Nina (Infra): OK temporary reservation in place. Post-demo follow-ups:
- educate on batching and per-item expansion in runbook
- add sample SDK quickstart that highlights batching for bulk imports
- document mismatch between request-rate quotas and token/embedding accounting

Ravi (SE): I'll open a short playbook entry for SEs to request per-route reservations for POCs with large imports (include ticket template and minimum lead time).

Tara (Sales): Demo went through. Customer still concerned about predictable POC behavior for longer tests — asks about a predictable trial plan. Can we propose a simple pre-approved reservation for trial customers?

Nina (Infra): We can propose a trial addon: small per-route reservation pool with limits and opt-in. I'll draft a proposal and share in #product later today.

Leo (Oncall): Closing temp reservation will be automated after the TTL but I'll keep the ticket open until the proposal is in place.

Tara (Sales): Thanks team — great swift response. I'll note the mitigation and next steps in the customer-facing ticket. :thumbsup:
